scope: Eligibility decision, executable tolerance/refinement guards, certified classical numerical reference and conditional volume-derivative budget; no new physical CST validation data

reference.time_coordinate: x=T/T_end; the same physical T_end for every mass

decision: PASS only if complete simultaneous uncertainty interval is contained in the closed tolerance band; FAIL if disjoint; otherwise HOLD. Any unknown required uncertainty is HOLD, never zero.

family.claim: finite family at declared times, not whole-time continuum convergence

physical_refinement.required_mode: regulated candidate with predeclared physical matching; physical-constant scans are a different model-family claim
allowed_to_change: element count implied by fixed physical domain
microscopic couplings along the frozen matching trajectory
numerical budget under separate accuracy certification

numerical_reference.scheme: forward Euler with outward Decimal intervals; separate analytic exact-arithmetic global error enclosure
numerical_reference.interpretation: checks inserted classical Einstein-dust dynamics; not physical lambda refinement
numerical_reference.negative_force_scope: exact initial acceleration only; no modified-force evolution

volume_derivative_budget.scope: conditional diagnostic of the prior whole-ball Poisson volume adapter, not primary CST data
volume_derivative_budget.window: prior symmetric (1,1) time windows, clipped to [0,T_end]
volume_derivative_budget.D1: three-point central inside, three-point one-sided at endpoints
volume_derivative_budget.D2: three-point central inside, three-point one-sided at endpoints
volume_derivative_budget.interpretation: sufficient bound; failure to certify is not an impossibility theorem, and covariance-aware or direct estimators may improve it

controls: perfect classical data cannot qualify CST
shrinking domain at fixed expected N
shared initial velocity violates mass response

budget.allowed: local deterministic and analytic controls only
